about: You are a pig on the run, and someone is hunting you down! Dash, sneak, and use the environment to your advantage to avoid capture. Navigate through forests, fields, and villages, find hiding spots, and overcome obstacles with clever tactics. Every choice matters—will you escape to freedom or end up in your pursuer’s grasp?

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
